review_notes: Wall thickness is generated inward using a stable normal offset; the approved exterior vertices remain unchanged.
This baseline closes exposed section and panel-window boundaries with 1.8 mm rim walls.
The center-split bottom halves are joined to their lower shells by the lower-shell closure geometry; only the eye-adjacent opaque islands remain separate and require internal frame ribs.
The compact rear-base frame is coplanar with the sloped rear edges of the two upper-head shells, uses a 20 mm structural surround and extends 18 mm inward; the lower rear panels remain uncut.
The mirrored bottom/throat openings inherited from the accepted surface are closed integrally by the lower shells.
Ventilation is reserved for protected rear-facing features; bottom drainage will use small deliberate holes rather than an open throat.
Seam flanges, keys, fastener pockets, and ear-root hardware are not included yet.
